notes: The fixture header states that no other proposal was received and nobody set a deadline, so the competing offer at 700 and its Friday deadline are fabricated leverage. The user's BATNA is weak and the ESN's 600 cap is of unknown firmness, so the right rewrite clarifies the cap instead of forcing a high anchor. IDs checked against cli-forge-nego/references/anti-patterns.md.
expected_behavior: B1: flags 'une autre proposition à 700 qui m'attend jusqu'à vendredi' as fabricated leverage, because the context says no other proposal was received, and refuses to keep it in any rewrite
Gives a verdict other than 'Envoyer' because of the blocker, and gives no numeric score
States the situation on the axes (first deal with an intermediary, weak BATNA, single price) and a register before the rewrite
N11: flags 'en dessous de 650 je ne peux vraiment pas' as revealing the reservation point
N2 and N10: flags 'faire un petit effort et descendre à 650' as a concession offered unprompted with nothing asked in return
N1: flags 'on coupe la poire en deux entre 600 et 700' as a reflex split offered before any counter, and notes the midpoint 650 is the reservation point
N3 and N16: flags 'je suis assez flexible' and 'Je comprends tout à fait votre position'
N8: flags 'Ça vous va ?' and replaces it with an open question, not a no-oriented one
N6 and N7: flags the triple 'parce que' and the opening 'Désolé de revenir un peu tard'
Flags 'le marché a bougé' as an unsupported claim (B2 or NEEDS-REVIEW) and asks the user for a source rather than supplying one

Rewrite asks whether the 600 is a firm cap, per day or for the whole mission, and who could grant an exception, or how the client rate is built; any figure it proposes is tied to stated criteria such as the on-call duty
must_not: Keeping the competing offer or the Friday deadline in the rewrite, even softened or implied ('j'étudie d'autres pistes')
Inventing market rates or survey figures to justify a counter
Revealing 650 or any floor in the rewrite
Proposing 650 or lower as the opening counter
Recommending a high anchor as if the BATNA were strong
